content: Iesuꞌa Bana Madaḡano Ugi Vazeḡa Fainiro
Bana Madaḡa ꞌahogano Iesuꞌa Farisea azaḡa ibitoziꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌahoga neo ogomu anoga veize onamiro. Ebu vaze nuꞌa ani uhiḡano ḡiaḡiane radiro.
Eꞌea Iesu zamao vaze ꞌahogaꞌe uginadu ꞌevoꞌa zu odaḡaꞌe miniroteꞌeꞌa radiro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa zu Farisea azaḡa ḡadiziro, “Zaꞌa zamareꞌetene Bana Madaḡano ugi vazeḡa fainogaꞌe idaḡa ga mene?”
Zeꞌa mene naenaeniro. Iesuꞌa ꞌevoꞌa hina ugi vazeḡa oboneꞌenaꞌa, fainadu tuḡune vaḡiniro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa ziro, “Zae boꞌaḡano Bana Madaḡano iniu ubuga ga boromakauꞌa idu vuḡa zamaḡano ovoine, ḡarihe mae ḡihiniꞌuma ga mene?”
ꞌOuge reirotene, ze mene naenaeniro.
Nize mae Ovoroꞌi
Muio huziroteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa hitana ehoroḡano ehoroga Iesuꞌa horozirotene, hari ꞌahoga idaniro,
“Vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa hahu muiḡa auḡoga veize ḡa huḡadoꞌidene, hitana ehoroḡano ago ehoroꞌi. Mazaḡa ufeta hitaga vazeḡa zuni hunine,
ḡanine huzateꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa ḡa vaḡe aradu ꞌahige ḡeꞌuma, 'Ḡae ehoro habaꞌa vaze ꞌadi hanoꞌi.' ꞌOugine, ḡa mazagaroꞌadu ḡonaga ehoroḡa onamiꞌuma.

Eꞌanoꞌo mui vazeḡaniꞌa huḡadoꞌidene, ḡonaga ehoroḡano ehoroꞌi. ꞌOugine, huḡadiroteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa horoꞌadu ḡa vaḡe ariꞌuma, ebu ꞌahige ḡeꞌuma, 'Eḡe vaze, iḡunadu hitana ehoroḡano ehoroꞌi.' ꞌOugine, ḡae teite huziroteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa ḡa niguꞌiꞌuma.
Iniu vaze aneꞌa bare niḡa mae itine, Badiꞌaꞌa niḡa mae ovoiꞌuma, u iniu vaze aneꞌa bare niḡa mae ovoine, Badiꞌaꞌa niḡa mae itiꞌuma.”

Ebu Iesuꞌa ani huniroteꞌe vazeḡa niro, “Madai ogomu ga ḡorava ogomu veize vaze huzoꞌidene, vazeḡo, negoḡo, nabugo ga ḡae uhiḡano radiuꞌeteꞌe maꞌora azaḡa ago huzoꞌi. ꞌOugine zeꞌa ḡa bare naenae huḡadadu ḡaeꞌa haḡaiḡo naeḡa meꞌuma.
Rehano ḡa mui madaḡano zahara azaḡa, oda sauꞌa azaḡa, edanoga mene idaḡa azaḡa ebu ubumaze kuruḡa azaḡa huzoꞌi.
ꞌOugine ḡaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa manohuga ḡaniꞌuma. Zeꞌe baronoḡanogaꞌe mene idaḡa ꞌahine, duduḡa azaḡaniꞌa bare ḡaboditeꞌe madaḡano, ḡaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa haḡaiḡo naeḡa ḡaniꞌuma.”
Mui Boro Hari Idaidaḡa
Iesu teite ogau radiroteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa Iesu ḡoere egadu Iesu niro, “Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano ogau tiburuꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe matuꞌeꞌohe.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa niro, “Mada ꞌahogano vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa mui boro ruhibadu vaze ḡehaḡa huziro.
Mui madaḡa reirotene, ani tuḡure vazeḡa ꞌahoga huziroteꞌe azaḡa vaḡe tuḡunadu ꞌahige rae ziro, 'Mui boro veize ḡau niduꞌa izidi ruhibeha. Eꞌanoꞌo zae niduꞌa aroꞌi.'
Rehano zeḡe niduꞌaꞌe ḡoere nunufiro. Ibite huniroteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa raenaꞌa, 'E haba iziga hoiteha, eꞌanoꞌo e haba eꞌe ḡiani onamihi. E mene amateꞌe moneo ago maḡunoꞌi.'
Ebu vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa raenaꞌa, 'E boromakau gaubanana hoiteha. Eꞌanoꞌo e ze manoga ga meneꞌe tuhune nurihi. E mene amateꞌe moneo ago maḡunoꞌi.'
Ebu vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa raenaꞌa, 'E iziduꞌu hahureha, eꞌanoꞌo e mene amiꞌuma.'

Tuḡure vazeḡaniꞌa bare onamadu zeꞌa reiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa zuhiꞌaḡa ihoniro. Ihonirotene mui vazeḡaꞌe maḡune rudaro ebu tuḡure vazeḡa niro, 'Ne ibi boroboro zu ibi komeꞌakomeꞌa ḡarihe onamadu zahara azaḡa, oda sauꞌa azaḡa, ubumaze kuruḡa azaḡa zu edanoga mene idaḡa azaḡa zamaze aroꞌi.'
Ebu tuḡure vazeḡaniꞌa onamadu ꞌouge haḡairo, ebu baradu zuhiꞌaḡa niro, 'Zuhiꞌa, ḡaꞌa ehateꞌe gauḡa haḡaeha, rehano ne ꞌize mene iriꞌaveha.'
Zuhiꞌaḡaniꞌa tuḡure vazeḡa niro, 'Ibi boro zu ibi komeꞌa onamoꞌi ebu vaze niduꞌa teꞌoteꞌozadu zamaze aroꞌi. Vazeꞌe eḡe ne iri'avonoꞌi.
Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, ibite mui veize huziroteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌaꞌe eḡe mui tahiḡa zuni mene auḡiꞌuma.'”
Iesu Hegoteꞌeteꞌe Ibiḡa
Mada ꞌahogano vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa Iesu teite ragavinu. Ebu Iesuꞌa vaetadu ziro,
“Iniuꞌa eḡe ḡaruna hegotoga uratoꞌidene, eḡe zamare borofoꞌi. Iniuꞌa moga zu viꞌa, inuga zu ubuga, negoḡa zu ezeḡa, ebu ḡaboneḡaꞌe eḡe ufeta vitihe zamare borofine, aniꞌe eḡe mene tahiꞌa reꞌuma.
Iniuꞌa ane satauro odohadu eḡe ḡaruna mene hegotine, aniꞌe eḡe mene tahiꞌa reꞌuma.
Zae boꞌaḡano vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa hitaga neḡa ogoranoga uratine, ibite geno ehoradu hadi nugu hina ogoru hauḡiꞌuma rae zamariꞌuma, zu hadiḡaꞌe ne eꞌe ogoranoga veize idaḡa ga meneꞌe ḡianiꞌuma.
Aniꞌa iḡite ohonadu mene ogoru hauḡine, vaze ḡehaḡaniꞌa eꞌe horonadu ḡirihohaꞌuma.
Zeꞌe ꞌahige reꞌuma, 'Vaze ꞌadiꞌe ne ohoniro, rehano hauḡogaꞌe mene idararo.'
Ebu kini ꞌahoganiꞌa kini ꞌahoga teite uti onamine, ani ibite geno ehoradu ꞌahige rae zamariꞌuma, 'Eḡe uti azaḡaꞌe 10,000 ebu ani uti azaḡa 20,000. E kini eꞌe teite utitine, ani vitiniꞌuma ga mene?'
Ani vitinoga mene idaḡa reine, kini eꞌe ꞌize faḡano radiuꞌeteꞌea, ani teite uniho manoḡa mouga veize hari odohe dureꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa tuḡuniꞌuma.
Eꞌe teige, zae boꞌaḡano iniuꞌa ane ḡau niduꞌa moditeꞌe moneo ibite mene zamarine, aniꞌe eḡe mene tahiꞌa reꞌuma.”
Dama Mene Iniga
Ebu Iesuꞌa ziro, “Zaꞌe dama heuḡa. Damaꞌe manoḡa, rehano iniganiꞌa dauḡine, nougenouge bare inidaꞌuma?
Dama mene inigaꞌe raha ga ogomu ḡuhuneꞌeteꞌe busiḡa veize zuni mene manoḡa ꞌahine, mae modeꞌohe. Teḡaḡeta vazeḡaꞌe faifaine egadu huga ederoꞌi.”
